absolutive expressing act of causing satisfaction or delight
prescribes the concluding act of formal dismissal

items.question: Which concluding ritual acts must precede the formal dismissal of the deity?
premises: The officiant must first perform worship.
The officiant must then make offerings.
The officiant must cause satisfaction before dismissal.
Formal dismissal follows these completed acts.
items.inference: Therefore dismissal is performed only after worship, offering, and pleasing are completed.
uncertainties: The precise nuance of prarocya as pleasing or gratifying is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Having worshipped, having offered, and having pleased the deity, one should dismiss them.
